title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a package-less action save on an object no package binds the name to writes the environment's own action
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_
Fixes #34059

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches where a package-less save of a writable package's item is written; `skills/objectstack-platform` teaches only the managed base's `.custom` pair, whose refusals do not move.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：环境不带包名保存一个动作（`PUT /meta/action/NAME`，无 `?package=`），无论直接保存还是草稿保存（`?mode=draft`）再按条发布，只要持有这个名字的包都把它绑在别的对象上，就写成环境自己的动作行，绑在本次保存的对象上；包里的动作原地不动。ADR-0150 D4 增补注记与 R15 指针、`SaveMetaItemRequest.packageId` 的说明随本 PR 落地。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决 6902014292（方案 B）：动作按 ADR-0150 D4 的键 `(package, objectName, name)` 认定。以前这种保存被改写进那个包，把包的动作从 A 对象挪到 B 对象，回执还写着包名；草稿门与按条发布有同样的缺陷。
- 风险与回滚：只对 `action` 生效；同对象保存、其它类型、托管（代码）包照旧。BREAKING（收窄）：原来写进包（或被 409、422 拒绝）的几种保存现在写成环境行，逐条列在 changeset。尚未改的：环境行没有不带包名的按名读取、不在列表里，不带包名的删除删掉的是包的行（#33904）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`（风险 hunk：`packagelessActionKeyedAddress` 与 `servedPackagelessSaveAddress` 新增的 `atObject` 分支）→ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`（`actionHeldOnlyOnOtherObjects` 与 `resolveWriteHead` 的草稿分支）→ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`（按条发布的 `promoteInto`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts -t "ADR-0150 D4"`，预期 16 个用例全绿；在 main 上标 FROM 的负向用例转红（回执写着包名，包的动作被挪走）。
- 需要你做的：Tier H，合并要维护者本人批准；contract review owed（PASS 记录出现后把 id 填在这里）。

## What changes

ADR-0150 D4 keys an action `(package, objectName, name)`, and the ruling on #34059 (6902014292, option B) puts that key on every door that writes an action naming no package. The doors used to address such a write by name alone: into the one package whose active row holds the name, whatever object that package binds it to, so the package's declaration moved onto the saved object.

- **One rule.** `actionHeldOnlyOnOtherObjects` (`sys-metadata-repository.ts`, module-level, not exported from the package entry) reads the item's active rows: true when some row is bound to a package and none of those rows binds the object the body binds (`boundObjectOf`, the owner-key reader the read side uses; object-less is its own key). A stored body that does not parse counts as binding the body's object, so it never drops a holder. `actionRowsBindingObjectOf` is the object filter it reads.
- **Publish-mode save.** `saveMetaItemUnaudited` asks `packagelessActionKeyedAddress` after the address is read. When the rule holds, `packageId` stays empty and the save writes the package-unbound row. When some holder binds the body's object and another binds another object, the served step (`servedPackagelessSaveAddress`, `atObject`) judges the holders at the body's object only: it skips the by-name read judgment and the by-name content package, and with only disabled holders there, the address is theirs, as `packagelessAddress` answers a name only disabled packages hold. Every holder on the body's object: unchanged.
- **Draft save.** `SysMetadataRepository.resolveWriteHead` takes the body (from `put`, and from `headAt` for the save's parent and receipt). Under the rule a package-less `draft` write inherits no package. The save door's draft address for the named-base and late-override gates is the package-unbound draft too.
- **Per-item publish.** `promoteDraftForPublish`, naming no package, over an unbound action draft that would be adopted into the holder: under the rule it is promoted into the package-unbound row.
- **ADR and spec prose.** The ADR-0150 amendment note under D4's customization paragraph and the R15 pointer (lifted for this PR by the ruling); one clause in `SaveMetaItemRequest.packageId`'s `.describe`, with `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, re-checked green).
- Not changed: every other type; a save naming a package; managed (code) packages, refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` by the door's sealed gate and the repository's store backstop before the address is read; two enabled holders, one on the body's object, still `409`.

Every moved answer (writable `P`, `Q`; `GONE` a package that is not installed):

| Shape | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `P` on `invoice`, save bound to `task` | `200`, receipt `package=P`; `P`'s row moved to `task` | the environment's row on `task`; `P`'s untouched |
| `P` on `invoice`, object-less save | same move | the environment's object-less row |
| `P` on `invoice`, `Q` on `product`, save bound to `task` | `409` naming both | the environment's row on `task` |
| `P` disabled, sole holder on `invoice`, save bound to `task` | written into `P`'s row | the environment's row on `task` |
| sole row on `invoice` bound to `GONE`, save bound to `task` | `422` naming `GONE` | the environment's row on `task` |
| `P` enabled on `invoice`, `Q` disabled on `task`, save bound to `task` | into `P`, its action moved to `task` | `Q`'s row on `task`; `P`'s untouched |
| draft save bound to `task` over `P` on `invoice` | `P`'s draft (receipt `package=P`) | the environment's draft (no package in the receipt) |
| its per-item publish naming no package | over `P`'s row on `invoice` | the environment's row on `task` |
| draft save bound to `task` beside a sole row bound to `GONE` | `422` | the environment's draft |

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`, describe `[ADR-0150 D4] a package-less save of an ACTION on an object the holder does not bind`: 11 negative pins (receipt and rows; `?package=P` read; a second save; object-less; two holders on two other objects; sole disabled holder; sole uninstalled binding; enabled holder beside a disabled holder at the body's object; the draft save with its receipt; the draft save beside an uninstalled binding; the per-item publish) and 5 CONTROLs (same-object draft and its publish stay `P`'s; same-object save; the same with the environment's row stored; a holder on each object `409`; managed `403`, nothing written).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-save-packageless-other-object.dogfood.test.ts` (real showcase boot over HTTP): the measured cell; the draft save and `POST /meta/action/NAME/publish` leg (`?package=P` still serves `showcase_invoice`; `/actions/_env/showcase_task/NAME` judges the environment's); the same-object and managed CONTROLs; and FROM pins for what does not move yet: the bare by-name read serves `P`'s item, and a package-less `DELETE` answers `Deleted action 'NAME' (package=P), and it still exists: its package-less row remains`, after which `?package=P` is `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (held by the environment only).

<details><summary>Ablations (ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to blob == HEAD with git diff HEAD empty; trap restore on exit)</summary>

Unit file, source-resolved (`./protocol.js`, no dist step), `-t 'ACTION on an object the holder does not bind'`:

- D-draft, `resolveWriteHead`'s rule (`if (body !== undefined && actionHeldOnlyOnOtherObjects(` to `if (false && …`): 2 failed, the draft save (`Received "com.qa.lanebapp"` for the draft's binding) and the per-item publish.
- P-publish, `promoteInto = null;` to `void 0;`: 1 failed, the per-item publish (P's row overwritten).
- S3-atobject, the keyed address (`if (actionRowsBindingObjectOf(item, held).length === held.length) return undefined;` to `if (held.length >= 0) …`): 1 failed, `Expected … package=com.qa.otherapp …`, `Received … package=com.qa.lanebapp …` (the FROM).
- E-envown, the environment-own arm (`if (actionHeldOnlyOnOtherObjects(type, item, activeRows)) return 'environment';` to `if (activeRows === null) …`): 7 failed, every publish-mode negative pin, including the sole disabled holder (`Received … package=com.qa.lanebapp …`) and the uninstalled binding (`Cannot save action 'approve_p' without naming a package: its stored rows are bound to package 'com.qa.uninstalled', which is not installed`).
- H-head, the save's write head body (`body: request.item,` to `body: undefined,`): 1 failed, the draft receipt (`Received "Saved action 'approve_p' (env-wide, package=com.qa.lanebapp, state=draft) [seq=2]"`).
- G-gates, the draft gates' address (`=== 'environment'` to `=== 'never'`): 1 failed, the draft beside the uninstalled binding (the `422` text above).
- Round 1 (head `0e5faaaa`, still in force): A1 removing the exception, 5 negative pins red, also on `dist/` for the dogfood cell; A2 over-broad, the three CONTROLs red; A3 the managed CONTROL red only with both the door gate and the store backstop lifted.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **#34263 (the ADR-0150 note card)**: this PR carries the note the card asks for, as the ruling binds. The card has no claim of its own, so it is not closed by keyword. The area closes it by hand when this PR merges.
- **Not moved yet, routed to #33904** (the read, list and delete half): the environment's row has no bare by-name read and is not in `GET /meta/action`; a package-less `DELETE` of the name removes the holder's row. `/actions/_env/OBJECT/NAME` is the address that reaches the environment's row today. The changeset states all three; the dogfood file pins them as FROM.
- **Edge, not changed:** with `P` holding its own draft and the environment's unbound draft both stored, the per-item publish naming no package promotes `P`'s draft (`packagelessDraftAddress` returns `P`'s key first); the environment's draft is reached once `P`'s is published or discarded. The address's wrapper lives in `protocol.ts`, outside this surface.
- `protocol-history-and-publish.ts` is touched (the per-item publish), beyond the surface the amendments name, because the publish is the second half of the draft door and the address wrapper is in `protocol.ts`.
